cards.title: Rating scale, notchChange and notchCalculator (src/ratings/notch.mjs)
cards.context:
WHY: REQ-06-02 notch calculator. Pure, synchronous ESM module imported by exact name. T-02 builds on notchChange, so names/signatures are a frozen contract.

REPO RULES (CLAUDE.md): Node 18+, ESM .mjs, no npm dependencies. Tests use node:test and node:assert/strict at test/<area>/<name>.test.mjs. src/ratings stays pure: no I/O, no console, only relative project imports (none needed).

FILES: create src/ratings/notch.mjs and test/ratings/notch.test.mjs.

EXPORTS: named exports only, exactly RATING_SCALE, notchChange, notchCalculator. No default export, no other exports; helpers stay module-private. All synchronous.

1) RATING_SCALE = Object.freeze(["AAA","AA+","AA","AA-","A+","A","A-","BBB+","BBB","BBB-","BB+","BB","BB-","B+","B","B-","CCC+","CCC","CCC-"]) (19, best first). push('CC') throws TypeError, length stays 19.

2) Input normalisation (all functions): FIRST typeof value === 'string' else throw RangeError (never call .trim() on non-strings: that would be a TypeError). Then value.trim() (String.prototype.trim only), .toUpperCase(), look up in RATING_SCALE; not found -> RangeError. No inner-whitespace or look-alike normalisation: 'BB B', 'BBB\u2212', en dash, fullwidth letters all throw. Off-scale ratings (CC, C, RD, SD, D, NR, WD, Baa1, AAA+) throw. Message names the argument (previous/current) and quotes the value, e.g. `Invalid rating for previous: "Baa1"`; tests assert only the type.

3) notchChange(previous, current) = index(current) - index(previous), -18..18. Positive = downgrade, negative = upgrade, unchanged = +0 never -0 (plain subtraction; no negation or Math.sign). Test with Object.is(result, 0).

4) notchCalculator(previous, current) returns a new plain object with exactly { notches, direction, wl }: notches = notchChange(...); direction 'downgrade' if >0, 'upgrade' if <0, 'unchanged' if 0; wl (Indicator 13 thresholds) n<=1 -> 0, n===2 -> 1, n>=3 -> 2; never above 2, upgrades 0.
IMPORTANT: the POC example 'BBB+ -> BB+ = 2 notch, WL=1' is wrong (clarification C2) and must NOT appear as test data: BBB+ -> BB+ is 3 notches, wl 2. A 1-notch downgrade gives wl 0 here (C6), intentionally different from T-02's Indicator 12 result. No separate Indicator 13 export.

TESTS (TDD): every value in the acceptance checks, exhaustive loop over all 361 ordered pairs (AC-10), the RangeError list in both argument positions for notchChange and notchCalculator, frozen-scale checks, export surface (dynamic import + Object.keys sorted). File name *.test.mjs.
acceptance: AC-1: RATING_SCALE deep-equals the 19 C1 ratings AAA..CCC- in order; length 19; frozen; push('CC') throws TypeError and length stays 19
AC-2: notchChange('BBB+','BBB') → 1, ('BBB+','BBB-') → 2, ('BBB+','BB+') → 3, ('AAA','CCC-') → 18, ('CCC','CCC-') → 1
AC-3: notchChange('BB+','BBB+') → -3, ('BBB','BBB+') → -1, ('CCC-','AAA') → -18
AC-4: for each of the 19 ratings r, notchChange(r, r) → 0 and Object.is(result, 0) (never -0)
AC-5 (notch part): notchChange(' bbb+ ','BB+') → 3; ('Bbb+','\tbb+\n') → 3; ('\u00A0aaa\u00A0','AAA') → 0; notchCalculator('bbb+','bbb-') → { notches: 2, direction: 'downgrade', wl: 1 }

AC-6 (notch part): notchChange and notchCalculator throw RangeError (not TypeError, never a value) in either argument position for '', '   ', 'BB B', 'Baa1', 'BBB\u2212', 'AAA+', 'CC', 'C', 'D', 'SD', 'NR', null, undefined, 7, {}, ['BBB']
AC-7: notchCalculator('BBB+','BB+') deep-strict-equals { notches: 3, direction: 'downgrade', wl: 2 }; ('BBB+','BBB-') → { 2, 'downgrade', 1 }; ('AAA','CCC-') → { 18, 'downgrade', 2 }
AC-8 (notch part): notchCalculator('BBB+','BBB') → { notches: 1, direction: 'downgrade', wl: 0 }
AC-9: notchCalculator('BB+','BBB+') → { -3, 'upgrade', 0 }; ('BBB','BBB+') → { -1, 'upgrade', 0 }; ('CCC-','AAA') → { -18, 'upgrade', 0 }; ('A','A') → { 0, 'unchanged', 0 } with Object.is(notches, 0)
AC-10: for all 361 ordered pairs notches === notchChange(p,c); direction downgrade/upgrade/unchanged by sign; wl 0 when notches<=1, 1 when ===2, 2 when >=3; never above 2
AC-15 (notch part): Object.keys of src/ratings/notch.mjs sorted → ['RATING_SCALE','notchCalculator','notchChange']; no default export; functions return non-Promise values
AC-16 (notch part): node --test passes; package.json has no dependencies; src/ratings/notch.mjs has no I/O, console output or non-relative imports

cards.title: Indicator 12 country rating change WL (src/indicators/countryRating.mjs)
cards.context:
WHY: REQ-03-12 Indicator 12 'country rating change': maps a sovereign rating change to WL 0-2. Pure, synchronous ESM module. Builds on notchChange from T-01 (src/ratings/notch.mjs), which is on the job branch once T-01 is merged.

REPO RULES (CLAUDE.md): Node 18+, ESM .mjs, no npm dependencies. node:test + node:assert/strict at test/<area>/<name>.test.mjs. src/indicators stays pure: no I/O, no console, only relative project imports.

FILES: create src/indicators/countryRating.mjs and test/indicators/countryRating.test.mjs. Do NOT modify src/ratings/**.

T-01 CONTRACT: `import { notchChange } from '../ratings/notch.mjs'`. notchChange(previous, current) = index(current) - index(previous) on the frozen 19-step scale; positive = downgrade, negative = upgrade, unchanged +0. It already trims, case-folds and throws RangeError for non-strings/unknown ratings in either position. Do NOT re-implement validation or a second scale; let its RangeError propagate unchanged.

EXPORT: exactly one named export `countryRatingChangeWl(previous, current)`; no default, no others. Exactly two parameters (Function.length === 2; no defaults/rest). Deterministic, no module state, synchronous.

THRESHOLDS (Indicator 12), n = notchChange(previous, current): n <= 0 -> 0 (upgrade/unchanged, C3); n === 1 -> 1; n >= 2 -> 2.
IMPORTANT: intentionally differs from notchCalculator's wl (Indicator 13): BBB+ -> BBB gives 1 here and 0 there. Do not harmonise; do not import notchCalculator.

OUT OF SCOPE: pre-filling from a public source (C4); override parameter/persistence/audit (C7) — 'editable' is met by the caller passing a different current value; output/printing (C8); CC/SD/D mapping (they throw).

TESTS (TDD): every listed value, exhaustive 361-pair loop against n = notchChange(p,c), RangeError list in both positions, function length and determinism, export surface via dynamic import + Object.keys.
acceptance: AC-5 (country part): countryRatingChangeWl('  a ','a-') → 1

AC-6 (country part): countryRatingChangeWl throws RangeError (not TypeError, never a value) in either argument position for '', '   ', 'BB B', 'Baa1', 'BBB\u2212', 'AAA+', 'CC', 'C', 'D', 'SD', 'NR', null, undefined, 7, {}, ['BBB']
AC-8 (country part): countryRatingChangeWl('BBB+','BBB') → 1, while notchCalculator('BBB+','BBB').wl → 0
AC-13: for all 361 ordered pairs result equals (n<=0 → 0, n===1 → 1, n>=2 → 2) with n = notchChange(p,c); always 0, 1 or 2
AC-14: previous 'BBB+': unedited current 'BBB' → 1, edited 'BB+' → 2; countryRatingChangeWl.length === 2; repeated calls give the same result (no state)
AC-15 (country part): Object.keys of src/indicators/countryRating.mjs → ['countryRatingChangeWl']; no default export; returns a non-Promise value
AC-16 (country part): node --test passes (exit 0); no dependencies in package.json; src/indicators imports only '../ratings/notch.mjs', no I/O or console output
